bundle.shortDescription: Disk usage analyzer and cache cleaner
bundle.longDescription: diska finds what is filling your disk: it lists the largest files and folders and reclaims regenerable caches behind a confirmation that names every path it will touch. Nothing is deleted permanently unless explicitly requested.
